rationale: Keep torch_tabr as the active sweep family. torch_scarf scaffold is in place and instantiates cleanly, but its 2-stage pretrain+finetune workload (even at CPU-friendly HPs: pretrain=10/finetune=20/batch=1024/enc=128x3) did NOT complete a single full gate run within the 30-min wall budget on CPU (CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' per project_gpu_policy). Designating torch_scarf as active would just stall train_mode against the same wall. torch_tabr W6 +311% / W7 +82% / W3 +61% jackpots from iter #2550 are still the best evidence-backed sweep target; pos_weight ∈ {1.0, 1.3, 1.5} single-lever order from the prior active_case rationale is unfinished. Re-route torch_scarf via Modal (`use_modal=True` like tabicl_v2) in a follow-up scaffold edit BEFORE designating it active.
